summary.business_type: B2B venue and event technology (platform plus professional services)
summary.scope_note: Site unpublished; project-level audit. Performance excluded and weights rescaled.
top_findings: No page titles or meta descriptions; site defaults are 'My Framer Site' / 'Made with Framer'
No tablet or phone breakpoints on any page or on the layout template
Two H1 headings in the homepage hero
Internal notes and placeholder copy in page text
quick_wins: Set site and per-page titles and descriptions
Add Organization JSON-LD in Custom Code

findings.title: No mobile or tablet breakpoints
findings.description: All 12 pages and the Corporate Layout template have only a Desktop breakpoint.
findings.recommendation: Add Tablet (810 px) and Phone (390 px) breakpoints and fix each section.

findings.title: Site not published
findings.description: Framer lists all pages as added; production URL is empty.
findings.recommendation: Publish on the custom domain, then verify robots.txt, sitemap.xml and canonicals.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Named founder, offices, client and certification

findings.title: Internal notes in page copy
findings.description: Notes such as 'Confirm investor naming' and 'to be confirmed before launch' appear in page text.

findings.title: Thin pages
findings.description: Service detail pages have 128-150 words; Contact 123; Careers 184.

findings.title: News items have no pages
findings.description: News collection has 2 items but no /newsroom/:slug detail page.
findings.recommendation: Create a CMS detail page and link to it.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single descriptive H1 on 11 of 12 pages

findings.title: No titles or meta descriptions
findings.description: All pages inherit 'My Framer Site' / 'Made with Framer'.
findings.recommendation: Set unique title and description per page (drafts in ACTION-PLAN.md).

findings.title: Two H1s on homepage
findings.description: Hero contains two copies of the H1 (nodes bvdxQfF4A and pE44kUZ06).

findings.title: Weak H1s and missing search terms
findings.description: /contact, /industries and /careers H1s lack keywords; 'software' is rarely used.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite H1s and use 'venue management software' phrasing.

findings.title: Weak internal linking
findings.description: /industries links only to /contact; /careers has no body links.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual links between industries, services and the case study.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.description: All custom code slots are empty.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization, WebSite, Service, NewsArticle and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

findings.title: Default metadata and no entity schema
findings.description: AI tools would read 'My Framer Site' and find no Organization markup.
findings.recommendation: Fix metadata and add Organization schema.

findings.title: Missing alt text
findings.description: 5 of 6 content images lack alt text (4 on the homepage, 1 on /industries).

findings.title: Not measured
findings.description: Site unpublished; no field or lab data.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Publish on custom domain and verify robots/sitemap/canonicals
